scope: Native panel menu accessible names through SwiftUI/AppKit sheet recreation
basis: Live baseline menus change from named titles with description drag to generic Drag after Channels Panel Options Escape. Native NSImage accessibilityDescription supplies the selected panel name.
APIImpact: Presentation-only control semantics; existing document API state, capability registry and Adobe compatibility surface unchanged. No new endpoint is applicable.

qualification.candidateLive: Color, Properties and Channels menu names retained after Channels Options Escape; Layers selection restores its matching name.

limitations: Exact cause of the initial API history409/413 conflict remains unproven; full and isolated retries passed without changing assertions or production guards.
Hosted accessibility traversal probes did not expose SwiftUI menu elements; do not count them as product regression coverage.
Utility-window live docking and broader channel editing remain pending.
No new Photoshop image-byte equivalence or complete Photoshop API conformance claim.
